Statistics of [[Czechoslovak First League]] in the 1970–71 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[FC Spartak Trnava]] won the championship. [[Jozef Adamec]] and [[Zdeněk Nehoda]] were the league's top scorers with 16 goals each.<ref>{{cite book|first=Luboš|last=Jeřábek|title=Český a československý fotbal - lexikon osobností a klubů|publisher=Grada Publishing|language=Czech|year=2007|location=Prague, Czech Republic|isbn=978-80-247-1656-5|page=232}}</ref>
